content: FOR. Deterministic e2e soak is the only gate that exercises crash-resume at the loop's real cadence — unit tests replay one boundary, the soak replays the whole decision sequence (escalation tiers, send dedup, respawn windows) under the exact intervals production uses. Scripted + seeded means any run-to-run trace diff is a reproducible bug, which is precisely what the durable-loop fixes (cg6.1/cg6.3) need to be proven, not asserted. Cheap to run, catches the midnight T3-halt class of failure that no single test reproduces.
